info.title: Tripz Backend API
info.description:
Multi-panel travel-marketplace backend exposing Super Admin, Admin, Vendor, Client, and Marketplace surfaces.

**Response envelope** — every endpoint returns:
- Success: `{ success: true, message: string, data: object | null }`
- Error: `{ success: false, message: string, errors: object | array | null }`

**Auth** — all authenticated endpoints expect a JWT access token via `Authorization: Bearer <token>`. Refresh tokens are delivered as an httpOnly cookie (web) and also in the JSON body (mobile / API clients).

**Account states** — vendors who submit KYC are immediately deactivated (`isActive=false`) and only re-activated when an admin approves/rejects the KYC. Login & refresh return `code: ACCOUNT_UNDER_REVIEW` while pending.

**Role values** — `CLIENT` (customer), `VENDOR` (agent), `ADMIN`, `SUPER_ADMIN`. The public signup endpoints accept only `CLIENT` and `VENDOR`.

**Password reset** uses a 3-step token-based wizard: forgot → verify-otp (returns short-lived JWT) → reset (uses JWT, no OTP retype).

post.summary: Register a new account (CLIENT or VENDOR)
post.description: Self-signup. `role: "CLIENT"` for customers, `role: "VENDOR"` for travel agents. ADMIN and SUPER_ADMIN cannot self-register. OTP is emailed for verification — no tokens issued here.

example.message: Account registered. Please verify your email to continue.

post.summary: Email + password login
post.description: Returns access (15 min) + refresh (7 days) tokens. Failure codes: `EMAIL_NOT_VERIFIED` (also re-sends OTP), `ACCOUNT_UNDER_REVIEW` (vendor KYC pending), `ACCOUNT_DEACTIVATED`.

value.message: Email not verified. We have sent a new verification code to your inbox.
Your application is under review. We will email you once your account is approved.
This account has been deactivated. Please contact support.

post.summary: Sign in (or sign up) with Google ID token
post.description:
- Existing Google account → log in (200)
- Existing email but no Google link → auto-link (provider → HYBRID), log in (200)
- Brand new → `role` required (`CLIENT` or `VENDOR`), creates + logs in (201)

201.description: New account created and signed in

400.description: Missing role on first-time signup, or invalid token

post.summary: Rotate refresh + access tokens
post.description: Refresh token read from httpOnly cookie OR JSON body. BOTH tokens are rotated. Replay attempts trigger revocation of ALL the user's refresh tokens.

post.summary: Revoke refresh token + clear cookie (idempotent)
Verify email with OTP
post.description: Consumes the latest active OTP. After verification, user must call `/auth/login` separately — no tokens issued here.

401.description: Invalid OTP, expired, exhausted attempts, or unknown email

post.summary: Resend email verification OTP
post.description: Generic-shape response (anti-enumeration). Rate-limited by `OTP_RESEND_COOLDOWN_SECONDS`.

200.description: Generic response (whether email exists or not)

example.message: Please wait 45s before requesting another code.

post.summary: Step 1 of password reset — request OTP
post.description: Sends an OTP email if the account exists. Generic-shape response prevents enumeration. Vendors awaiting admin review CAN reset their password (so they can prepare for re-login post-approval).

post.summary: Step 2 of password reset — verify OTP, issue reset token
post.description:
Validates the OTP from step 1. On success the OTP is CONSUMED and a short-lived JWT reset token (10 min TTL) is returned. The frontend stores this token and uses it in step 3 instead of re-sending the OTP.

Wrong OTP attempts increment the rate-limit counter; exhausted OTPs are auto-burned.

example.message: OTP verified. You can now set a new password.

401.description: Wrong OTP, expired, exhausted attempts, or unknown email

403.description: Account permanently deactivated (vendors under review are allowed)

post.summary: Step 3 of password reset — set new password using the reset token
post.description:
Takes the JWT reset token from step 2 (NOT the OTP). The token carries the user identity, so no email needed in the body. On success: updates password, revokes ALL refresh tokens (kicks out attackers), sends 'password changed' notice email.

Error codes:
- `RESET_TOKEN_EXPIRED` — token's 10-min TTL elapsed; restart from step 1
- `RESET_TOKEN_INVALID` — token tampered/wrong purpose/wrong signature

example.message: Password reset successfully. Please log in with your new password.

value.message: Reset session expired. Please request a new code.
Invalid reset session. Please request a new code.

post.summary: Upload an image or PDF to Cloudinary
post.description:
Authenticated upload. Files stored at `tripz/<purpose>/<userId>/<name-or-timestamp>`. Backend returns the public CDN URL.

If `name` is provided, the file is saved at that stable slot — re-uploads with the same name overwrite the previous file.

file.description: Max 5 MB. Allowed: image/jpeg, image/png, image/webp, application/pdf.

name.description: Optional. Stable slot name. Re-uploads with the same name overwrite the previous file.

post.summary: Submit a travel-inquiry lead (public, no auth required)
post.description:
Public anonymous form submission. If a valid Bearer token is sent, the lead is linked to that customer; otherwise `customerUserId = null`.

**Hybrid storage**: `destination`, `email`, `phone`, `budget` go to indexed columns; everything else lands in `requirements` JSONB. Leads land as `PENDING_REVIEW` until admin approves.

post.summary: Create an ADMIN user (SUPER_ADMIN only)
post.description: New admin is auto-activated and email-verified.

409.description: Email or phone already in use

post.summary: Activate a deactivated vendor account (SUPER_ADMIN only)
post.description: Force-flips `User.isActive` to `true`. Use this to reverse a previous deactivation. Action is logged with the SUPER_ADMIN's user ID. `reason` is optional but recommended for audit.

example.reason: Re-enabled after offline verification of company documents

post.summary: Deactivate a vendor account (SUPER_ADMIN only)
post.description: Force-flips `User.isActive` to `false`. ALSO revokes all of the vendor's refresh tokens — they can't extend their current session. `reason` is REQUIRED (min 5 chars) for audit.

example.reason: Repeated fraud attempts on lead unlocks

400.description: User is not a VENDOR, or validation failed

post.summary: Grant credits to a vendor's wallet (SUPER_ADMIN only)
post.description: Adds credits to the vendor's wallet (creates the wallet row if missing). Writes a `CREDIT_ADMIN_ADJUSTMENT` row to the wallet ledger with the SUPER_ADMIN's ID as the reference. Use for onboarding bonuses, promotional credits, refund-style top-ups, etc.

post.summary: Revoke credits from a vendor's wallet (SUPER_ADMIN only)
post.description: Atomically subtracts credits using CAS — fails with 402 if wallet balance is insufficient. Writes a `DEBIT_ADMIN_ADJUSTMENT` ledger row. `notes` is REQUIRED (min 5 chars) for audit. Use for disputed unlocks, fraud clawback, etc.

400.description: User is not a VENDOR, or validation failed (notes missing)

get.description:
Paginated table view of all vendors. Used by the Admin Dashboard's Vendors tab. Supports filters by KYC status, active state, and free-text search across email / first name / last name / phone.

**Pagination** accepts EITHER style — pick whichever your frontend prefers:
- **Offset-based**: `?take=10&skip=0` (Prisma-native, matches other admin endpoints)
- **Page-based**: `?page=0&size=10` (Spring Boot style, 0-indexed: `page=0` is the first page)

If both styles are sent, `page`/`size` wins. Response always includes `take`/`skip`/`total` so the frontend can compute total pages.

parameters.name: take
parameters.description: Offset-based pagination — page size (overridden by `size` if both sent)

parameters.name: skip
parameters.description: Offset-based pagination — number of rows to skip (overridden by `page` if both sent)

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Page-based pagination — 0-indexed page number. Equivalent to `skip = page * size`

parameters.name: size
parameters.description: Page-based pagination — items per page. Equivalent to `take = size`

get.summary: Get a single vendor's full detail
get.description: Returns everything for one vendor — user info, KYC profile + reviewer, all KYC documents (PAN/AADHAR/GSTIN/CIN with verification states), wallet balance, and the derived approval summary block. Single API call powers the Vendor Detail page.

approval.message: Your application is under review. We will email you once an admin approves your account.

post.summary: Approve vendor's KYC
post.description: Approves KYC and re-activates the vendor's account atomically. Approval email sent. Requires `kycStatus = SUBMITTED`.

post.summary: Reject vendor's KYC
post.description: Rejects with a reason, re-activates the vendor's account so they can log back in and fix issues, sends rejection email.

example.reason: PAN number does not match company name. Please re-upload.

get.summary: Get current KYC status + documents + approval summary

post.summary: Submit the KYC wizard (final step)
post.description:
Persists company-level fields and flips `kycStatus → SUBMITTED`.

**Side effects on success:**
- `User.isActive = false` (vendor locked out until admin decides)
- All refresh tokens revoked
- Vendor appears in admin review queue

Requires PAN to be third-party-verified.

400.description: Validation failed or terms not accepted

403.description: KYC already approved or already submitted

post.summary: Verify PAN via Surepass
post.description:
Real-time PAN verification via Surepass `/pan/pan`. Marks `thirdPartyVerified=true`.

**Idempotent:** if the same PAN is already verified for this vendor, returns cached result with `alreadyVerified: true` — NO Surepass credits consumed.

422.description: Surepass rejected (number not found in records)

post.summary: Save GSTIN (format-only validation, no third-party API)
post.description:
Format-only validation. Surepass is NOT called — saves credits. Marks `thirdPartyVerified=true` but with `thirdPartyProvider: "FORMAT_ONLY"` so admins know to manually verify the uploaded certificate.

**Idempotent:** same number returns cached result.

post.summary: Save CIN (format-only validation, no third-party API)
post.description:
Format-only validation, no Surepass call. Same pattern as GSTIN. Marks `thirdPartyVerified=true` with provider `"FORMAT_ONLY"`.

**Idempotent:** same number returns cached result.

post.summary: Step 1 of Aadhaar — start DigiLocker session
post.description:
Calls Surepass `/digilocker/initialize` and returns a DigiLocker SDK URL. The frontend opens this URL; user authenticates on DigiLocker. DigiLocker then redirects back to `SUREPASS_REDIRECT_URL`, and the frontend's callback page calls `/aadhaar/complete`.

**Idempotent:** if Aadhaar is already verified for this vendor, returns `alreadyVerified: true` and SKIPS the Surepass call.

value.message: DigiLocker verification initiated. Open the redirect URL to complete it.

post.summary: Step 2 of Aadhaar — fetch verified Aadhaar from Surepass
post.description: Called from the frontend callback page AFTER the user finishes DigiLocker. Backend uses the parked `client_id` to call Surepass `GET /digilocker/download-aadhaar/<client_id>` and persists the verified Aadhaar data. No OTP is passed — DigiLocker owns the OTP step.

400.description: Missing or invalid sessionId, or no pending Aadhaar session

401.description: Invalid session, expired, or DigiLocker not yet completed

get.summary: List the customer's own inquiries (with pagination)
get.description:
Returns leads owned by the currently logged-in CLIENT. This includes:
- Leads they submitted while logged in (linked at submission)
- Anonymous leads they submitted BEFORE registering, where the email matched — automatically linked at registration.

Customer DOES NOT see which vendors unlocked their lead (privacy + monetisation — vendors paid for the contact). They only see the unlock count.

get.summary: Browse active leads in teaser mode
get.description: Returns active leads. For leads the vendor has NOT unlocked, `email` and `phone` are masked. For unlocked leads, full contact details are returned. Requires APPROVED KYC.

403.description: KYC not approved or vendor deactivated

post.summary: Unlock a lead — debits the credit wallet atomically
post.description: Atomic Prisma transaction with two CAS-style updates: (1) reserve a slot on the lead, (2) debit the wallet. Any failure aborts everything. After success, returns the FULL unmasked lead.

value.message: You have already unlocked this lead.
This lead has just been fully claimed.
This lead is no longer available.

Unauthorized.description: Missing, malformed, or expired access token

Forbidden.description: Authenticated but role not allowed for this endpoint

ApprovalSummary.description: Derived from VendorProfile.kycStatus. Frontend uses this to decide what to show on the dashboard.

role.description: Required only for brand-new account creation.

VerifyResetOtpRequest.description: Step 2 of password reset wizard. On success the OTP is CONSUMED and a JWT reset token is returned.

ResetPasswordRequest.description: Step 3 of password reset wizard. The resetToken from step 2 carries the user identity — no email needed.

reason.description: Optional reason for the audit log.
Required reason for the audit log.

notes.description: Required reason for the audit log.
